A '''Rodian male''' was incarcerated on the [[Prison/Legends|prison]]-[[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kiffex/Legends|Kiffex]] and resided in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Deadend]]. In [[30 BBY/Legends|30 BBY]], his cloak was stolen by the criminal [[Vilmarh Grahrk]] for [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]], and the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] attempted to retrieve it from Vos at the [[Black Hole (Kiffex)|Black Hole]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]].
